RF-Scope APK build information
==============================

App name: RF-Scope
Package: com.rfscope.app
Version: 0.8.0 (versionCode 8)
Build type: debug (installable; Android Debug certificate)
Min SDK: 29 (Android 10)
Target/compile SDK: 34 (Android 14)
Built at: 2026-11-08 (Asia/Shanghai)
APK SHA-256: 2b238e61dc28eb7a2864149cf6458f0cae8de2ce9a9952d6482a4770ff002f79
Size: 24896682 bytes

Changes in 0.8.0:
- SmartSDR-style panadapter with dBm grid, colored trace, fill, and peak marker.
- Waterfall is frequency-locked to the spectrum with the same 48dp plot gutter.
- Trace and waterfall share the blue-cyan-green-yellow-red signal color scale.
- One scan creates one 2dp waterfall row; timestamps remain visible.
- Compact time and frequency rulers make the two displays directly comparable.
- Threshold line, auto-peak markers, and a compact TinySA menu dialog.

Notes:
- Debug certificate; not suitable for Play Store publishing.
- Hardware behavior depends on TinySA firmware and OEM USB implementation.
